title: LPG Sellers Overcharge Consumers by Over Rs. 1.4 Billion
excerpt: Consumers in Pakistan reportedly paid over Rs. 1.4 billion in extra charges for liquefied petroleum gas.
body_html:
Consumers in Pakistan have reportedly paid more than Rs. 1.4 billion in extra charges for liquefied petroleum gas (LPG).

According to reports, LPG sellers have been overcharging customers, resulting in the substantial extra earnings for the sellers over a short period.
